name: The Legend of Stalvan
summary: In Elwynn, your search for Stalvan Mistmantle reaches Marshal Haggard's home. The aging veteran's eyesight has failed, and an upstairs chest holds papers left behind when he moved in.

sections.title: A Veteran's Attic
sections.body: Marshal Haggard lives on Elwynn Forest's southeastern edge, near Duskwood and Redridge. An old chest upstairs holds parchments he found when he moved into his secluded home. His failing eyesight kept him from reading them, and they remain untouched until you ask about Stalvan.

sections.title: Lingering Shadows
sections.body: The papers in Haggard's upstairs chest stir a restless force tied to Stalvan's past. When his belongings are disturbed, a Forlorn Spirit appears. Among the papers, a journal page records Stalvan's own writings and shows that the reclusive scholar left his mark in Elwynn before vanishing.

faq.answer: Marshal Haggard is an aging veteran who lives in a secluded cabin in southeastern Elwynn Forest. His house holds old papers that belonged to Stalvan Mistmantle.

faq.q: Why did the trail lead back to Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Clues from Darkshire and Moonbrook trace Stalvan's travels across southern Stormwind territory. Haggard's home held papers Stalvan left behind.

faq.q: What is inside the chest upstairs?
faq.answer: The upstairs chest holds a faded journal page written by Stalvan Mistmantle, among parchments Haggard never managed to examine properly.

faq.q: Why does a spirit attack when the chest is opened?
faq.answer: A Forlorn Spirit haunts relics from Stalvan's past and attacks when an outsider disturbs his writings and memories.

faq.q: How does this advance the Stalvan investigation?
faq.answer: The faded page gives firsthand evidence in Stalvan's own hand, helping piece together his past.

faq.q: Why couldn't Marshal Haggard read the papers himself?
faq.answer: Age has left Haggard's eyesight weak and clouded, so he could not read the small, weathered writing on the faded papers.

angles.text: Tracing Stalvan's past brings you into the darker history hidden within Elwynn's peaceful farmlands.
As a human, you follow Stalvan through familiar settlements and see how isolation and malice can hide in plain sight.
